{{Quote|Our primary target is their Beetle Transports, but fire at will&mdash;we're going to take out as many of their outlying forces as we can on the way in.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] during the Defense of Orto Plutonia|<ref name="Defense of Orto Plutonia">{{TCWA|Defense of Orto Plutonia}}</ref>}}
The '''XT Beetle Transport''' was a model of [[Transport/Legends|transport]] used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]<ref name="Episode Guide" /> and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="Trespass" /> that moved on ten pairs of mechanized [[Limb/Legends|legs]].<ref name="The Complete Season One">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]]</ref>

==History==
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Trespass Date">{{TCWdates|115}}</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Trespass" /> a pair of XT Beetles with [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] markings were pulled together by large cables to form a [[Separatist outpost (Orto Plutonia)/Legends|Separatist outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]].<ref name="Episode Guide" /> However, their [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] occupants were [[Skirmish on Orto Plutonia/Legends|destroyed]] by [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] warriors from a nearby [[Talz village/Legends|village]] and the vacant XT Beetles were later used as a "neutral" meeting ground for negotiations between the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantorans]], the inhabitants of the planet's primary [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]], who claimed Orto Plutonia as their [[Protectorate (government system)/Legends|protectorate]] and regarded the natives as trespassers, and the [[Homeworld/Legends|indigenous]] Talz, who simply desired to be left alone.<ref name="Trespass" />

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the Separatists returned to Orto Plutonia with several XT Beetles to reestablish a foothold on the planet and eliminate the Talz who attacked their original base. However, the Republic was able to [[Defense of Orto Plutonia|crush]] the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielded]] transports by destroying an overhanging [[Water/Legends|ice]] bridge, forcing the Separatist to retreat from the [[Pantora system/Legends|Pantora system]].<ref name="Defense of Orto Plutonia" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:XT_Beetle.png|thumb|220x220px|Concept art of the XT Beetle transport.]]
The XT Beetle Transport first appeared, albeit unidentified, in "[[Trespass]]," the fifteenth episode of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''{{'}} [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]],<ref name="Trespass">{{TCW|Trespass}}</ref> which originally aired on [[January 30]], [[2009]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Episode Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> It was later identified in the [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|episode guide]] for "Trespass" available on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Episode Guide" /> The XT Beetle's [[:File:XT Beetle.png|design]] was derived from [[:File:MTT concept art.jpg|early concept art]] of the [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transport]] developed by [[Doug Chiang]] for [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], a [[Wikipedia:Locomotive|locomotive]] stylized to resemble a [[Wikipedia:Revolver|revolver]] barrel.<ref name="The Art of Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace]]''</ref>

XT Beetle Transports later appeared in "Defense of Orto Plutonia," the thirteenth and final stage of the [http://cwa.wikia.com/wiki/Starfighter Starfighter] mini-game in [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']],<ref name="Defense of Orto Plutonia" /> a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment<ref name="Clone Wars Adventures">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref> that was released on [[September 15]], [[2010]]<ref name="Season 3 Premiere Announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/season3_date/index.html|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Season 3 Premiere Date Announced}}</ref> and shut down on [[March 31]], [[2014]].<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.clonewarsadventures.com/news/detail.action?articleId=1589|text=With Heavy Hearts, We Announce the Sunset of Clone Wars|author=George, Steve|date=2014-01-24|archivedate=20140331102701}}</ref>
